$comment: Copy to ~/.config/model-gateway/config.json (user-wide) or <repo>/.model-gateway.json (project). Keys can be literal or "${ENV_VAR}" references. Everything here is optional; built-in defaults cover the rest.
$comment_routing: Who picks the model when a run_plan/delegate task omits one. engine: off (default, an omitted model means defaults.model), rules (deterministic, no key, no network), or jev (TypeSafe System One; degrades to rules without a key). Override per session with the `routing` tool parameter or BREAK_FREE_ROUTING=jev|rules|off. A task's own `model` is never routed. See docs/routing.md.

routing.$comment_projectMayEnableJev: USER config only. true (default) lets a repo's .model-gateway.json turn on jev for itself, which is the same egress it already has via defaults.model. false keeps every routing decision on this machine; a project may then still ask for rules or off.

$comment_tripwire: A sub-second Jev check on what a crew diff actually DOES, run after verify passes: is a hunk weakening a test, destroying data, touching security, or wider than asked? Additive — it can add a review or a block, never remove one. It only runs for paths an action:"check" rule matches, so it costs nothing until you scope it. Thresholds are calibrated against TWO corpora: bench/tripwire-set.jsonl (130 diffs, 30 planted bad, the clean half adversarial -> recall 90%, false flags 14%) and bench/tripwire-natural.jsonl (175 hunks from 94 real merged commits -> false flags 4%, code-only 5%). 309ms p50, $0.043 per 1,000 diffs. See docs/tripwire.md.

tripwire.$comment_reviewRisk: 3.0, not 2.5. On real merged diffs `risk` caused 13 of 17 false flags — ordinary backend code scores 2.5-3.1 on the 0-4 scale — so 3.0 halves the real-world false-flag rate (10% -> 4%) at no cost to recall on the seeded set.
tripwire.$comment_confidenceThreshold: 0 disables the gate, which is the calibrated default: Jev's confidence on the risk Score is low on 48% of CLEAN diffs and 67% of bad ones, so gating on it flags half the clean set.
tripwire.$comment_skipPlanReview: false (default): a clean tripwire does not replace a blanket plan-level review. true lets all three gates clean (no denied path, required checks passed, nothing flagged) stand in for it, and the report says so.

$comment_policy: Enforced by the gateway, not by prompt text. deny: workers cannot read or write matching paths. review: an independent review by a DIFFERENT vendor runs on matching changes. check: runs the tripwire over diffs touching matching paths.

rules.reason: auth changes need a second vendor's review
a green test run is not proof the diff is honest
